title: the event log cannot answer where time goes across repos
desc:
events.path() is artifacts.root(cwd)/.events.jsonl, so history is per checkout. 'Where do I lose time across all my repos' is structurally unanswerable, which is the most useful question the log could answer. Framed in .workflow/idea-dashboard/frame.md as the ~20-line alternative to a dashboard with a database.

ACCEPTANCE:
- each event also appends to ~/.workbench/events.jsonl (WORKBENCH_HOME aware) with a repo field
- wb status --stats --global summarises that file instead of the local one
- the global log is capped and trimmed the same way the local one is
- WORKBENCH_NO_EVENTS=1 still disables both
- every failure stays swallowed: the log is never load-bearing
